info.title: AutoRestTest Backend API (safe subset)
info.description:
The subset of the AutoRestTest backend that is safe to exercise with an automated request generator.

**23 of 58 operations have been removed** because they send email, spend LLM quota, start engine runs against arbitrary hosts, revoke the session the test engine is authenticated with, or destroy the project under test. The full document is `autoresttest-backend.yaml`; the reasoning for each removal is in `EXCLUDED_ENDPOINTS.md`.

Run this against a **dedicated throwaway project and account**. Several of the operations left in are still destructive within their own project (deleting endpoints, deleting runs, removing members) — that is deliberate, because they are worth testing, but they will damage real data.

bearerAuth.description: Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` from login. Seven-day expiry.

Error.description: The error envelope every failing route returns.

message.description: A single message, or one per failed validation rule.

Role.description: A collaborator role on a project. The owner is implicit and never one of these.

LlmScope.description: One of the platform's three LLM surfaces.

PublicUser.description: The user shape returned everywhere. Never includes the password hash.

isAdmin.description: From the ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist, not a project role.

AuthSession.description: Returned by login and by finishing signup.

RegisterAccepted.description: No account exists yet at this point — a six-digit code was emailed.

verificationRequired.description: False when the deployment has verification switched off and the account was created outright.

fileContent.description: The raw specification document as uploaded or generated.

SpecGeneration.description: An asynchronous source-code-to-OpenAPI job. Poll until status is completed or failed.

generatedSpec.description: Present only once the job has completed and is awaiting review.

originSuiteId.description: Set on a replay: the run whose captured requests were resent.

description.description: Null until the describe pass has been run.

endpointId.description: Null means the engine mutated the HTTP method, so the log matched no endpoint.

RunRequestLogResult.description: The fresh response from live-resending one captured request. Nothing is persisted.

error.description: Set instead of a response when the fetch itself failed.

remaining.description: Call again while this is above zero.

GraphEdge.description: from produces a value that to consumes. Arrows read as execution order.

LlmSettings.description: A null field means no admin override: fall back to that surface's environment default.

username.description: Letters, numbers and underscores only. Immutable once created.

identifier.description: An email address OR a username. Told apart by the @ that usernames forbid.

token.description: The raw hex secret from the emailed link.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Deliberately does not accept username or email; both are rejected as unknown fields.

name.description: An empty string clears it back to the username.

PasswordConfirmRequest.description: A valid session is not enough for an irreversible delete.

UpdateProjectRequest.description: Both fields optional, but at least one must be present.

targetUrl.description: Live base URL the engine sends requests to. Must include http(s)://.

customHeaders.description: At most 20 pairs. Names must be RFC 7230 tokens; values may not contain CR or LF.

excludedEndpointIds.description: Endpoint ids stripped from the spec before this run.

UpdateLlmSettingsRequest.description: Partial update. Omit a key to leave it unchanged; send null to clear the override.
